explication: tldr-pages is a community-maintained corpus of concise, practical command examples, organized by operating system and language. The main user journey is to look up a command in a client and get its relevant help page. Contributors create or revise Markdown pages; translation directories hold localized versions, and repository scripts assist with common edits and synchronization. The PDF renderer offers a separate way to consume the corpus. The README documents client usage and PDF support; sampled source confirms editing helpers and PDF rendering, but not client internals.
